**Sepo implementation finished**

- Branch: `agent/implement-issue-7/claude-26178140427`
- Pull request: https://github.com/lm4sci/lm4sci.github.io/pull/8

Fixed two bugs introduced by PR #6 that caused the GitHub Pages deployment to fail. First, `src/content/2025/faq.mdx` and `src/content/2025/organizers.mdx` were using `'../components/Collapsible'` and `'../components/OrganizerGrid'` respectively — paths that were correct when the files lived at `src/content/` but broke after they were moved one level deeper to `src/content/2025/`. Both imports were updated to `'../../components/...'`. Second, the Next.js cache key in `.github/workflows/nextjs.yml` only hashed JS/TS files, not `.mdx` files, so moving MDX files didn't bust the cache; webpack restored a stale `.next/cache` whose `placeholder.js` still referenced the old flat file paths. The cache key was updated to include `**/*.mdx` in the hash and bumped to a `v2` prefix to immediately evict the stale cache on the next run.
